newsitem.title: USA: Columbia/HCA says wins trademark lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Columbia/HCA says wins trademark lawsuit.

text.p: Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp said on Monday that a federal judge in New York had dismissed a lawsuit brought by Columbia University against the company regarding use of the name Columbia.

U.S. District Judge John Koeltl cited the university's own admission that it did not have exclusive rights to the name and ruled that the company's use of the name is unlikely to cause confusion or violate any other rights of the university, the company said in a statement.
Columbia is a healthcare service provider with more than 340 hospitals, 140 surgery centers and 570 home health locations in the United States, England, Switzerland and Spain.
